documents.title: Filament guide - Printer, Nozzle, AMS, Build Plate, Glue Compatibility and Required Parameters

notes: hex: no Hex Code document is linked from the store page or cached for PAHT-CF; the one colour Black (70100) gets no published hex.
in_the_box: no official in-the-box list exists for this filament; none is invented.

TDS facts with no registry key, not stored: Young's Modulus (X-Y 3860 ± 230 MPa, Z 2180 ± 130 MPa); Z-direction mechanical values; notched impact X-Y 22.8 ± 1.8 kJ/m²; HDT 170 °C at 1.8 MPa; Melt Index 14.4 ± 2.0 g/10 min (280 °C, 2.16 kg); Crystallization Temperature 140 °C; Saturated Water Absorption 0.88% (25 °C, 55% RH); Spool Size 200 mm diameter, 67 mm height; Nozzle Size 0.4/0.6(recommended)/0.8 mm (kept as relations); Printing and Storage Humidity < 20% RH; Retraction 0.8 - 1.4 mm, 20 - 40 mm/s; Max Overhang ~70°; Max Bridging ~40 mm; Support Material: Bambu Support for PA/PET; annealing 80 to 130 °C, 6 to 12 h.
SDS facts with no registry key: Model "N04-xx"; composition Nylon 12 and copolymer 80-88 %, carbon fiber 12-20 %; not classified under CLP; not hazardous goods for transport.
The RoHS certificate linked from the store page (https://store.bblcdn.com/40190d6568d7406bacb58b3bcb09b783.pdf) is not cached: safety.certifications is neither stated nor marked not_published.
